chapter: Style and solos in the early bands
title: Ensemble playing, the word jazz, and the arrival of banjo solos
summary: Early bands played mostly ensemble, about three choruses, with few solos until banjoists like Caffrey came after he returned.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: Back before you went to California, when you were very young, how would the bands play a piece? How you mean? Well, I mean, would they start off loud or soft? Would everybody come in on the beginning?

Yeah, everybody. Everybody. It's like you're shocking them, everybody playing. Ensemble. That's right. That's right. That's right. That would be the beginning, huh? In the beginning. Then all right, if you had your trumpet player, he wanted to take a solo, well you let him take a solo. You take two, you're a trombone player, you're a clarinet player. But most was ensemble, see. Didn't do very much soloing, see. Didn't do very much. All the bands, just like you hear Shark and Al Wakeman play, well that's the way they was playing.
But more ensemble. Yeah, oh yeah, yeah.

All together, you know, all the Dixie Langues, we call it Dixie Langues, we call it break time then, you know, see. But it's the same, mean the same thing. We call it J-A-S-S first, then it comes to J-A-Z-Z. Doesn't mean all the same, yeah, see.
Well, at that time, you say you'd have your ensemble first. About how many choruses ensemble?

Oh, they'd play about three. About three on the choruses. Yeah, all together. Yeah, you see they play all. Now my idea, when they first started to play them solos, when they got the banjos? Yeah, the banjos. Yeah, you see. That guy was playing with us, Buddy Malady, you see, was playing with Buddy. When I was playing with Buddy, the guy was playing with Sam. Caffrey was playing on the roof guard. Now he was a fine solo man, little Caffrey. Fine. He couldn't read it, but I wish he had to get the banjo he would play.
And that was after you came back.
Yeah, see that was after I came back. So before they didn't have too much solo. No, didn't have too much. No, they didn't have too much before I left.
Well, say you had at that early period, before California, say you finished that three choruses ensemble, who would take down?
